faq.question: How many Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches are there?
faq.answer: There are 10 Heavenly Stems and 12 Earthly Branches. Together they form a 60-year cyclical system.

faq.question: Are Earthly Branches the same as zodiac animals?
faq.answer: Yes, each Earthly Branch is associated with a zodiac animal, but in Bazi they represent deeper elemental and seasonal energies.

content.text: The Foundation of the Bazi System

The Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches are the structural building blocks of the Four Pillars of Destiny. Every Bazi chart is created by combining one Heavenly Stem and one Earthly Branch for each of the four pillars: year, month, day, and hour.

The 10 Heavenly Stems represent the pure forms of the Five Elements in Yin and Yang polarity. Each element appears twice — once as Yang and once as Yin. For example, Yang Wood and Yin Wood express different energetic qualities.
Heavenly Stems are visible energies. They represent surface-level traits, personality expression, and outward behavior.

The 12 Earthly Branches correspond to the 12 zodiac animals, but their meaning goes far deeper. Each branch represents seasonal energy, environmental influence, and contains hidden elements known as hidden stems.
Unlike Heavenly Stems, Earthly Branches contain layered energy. They influence subconscious patterns, long-term cycles, and deeper structural themes.

Each pillar combines one Heavenly Stem and one Earthly Branch. The Stem represents visible energy, while the Branch represents hidden or environmental energy. Together, they create dynamic interactions such as combinations, clashes, and transformations.
Because there are 10 stems and 12 branches, they rotate in sequence to create a 60-combination cycle. This 60-year cycle forms the basis of Chinese calendrical time and destiny analysis.
Why They Matter in Your Chart
Your Day Master is a Heavenly Stem. Its strength depends heavily on the surrounding Earthly Branches. Understanding this interaction is key to reading your chart correctly.
Heavenly Stems represent visible elemental energy. Earthly Branches represent cyclical and hidden energy. Together, they form the energetic DNA of your life structure.
